Every tool documented on this page ships together in a single file, `CommaTs.tsep` — one install gives you every plugin below, both macro libraries, the Comma ribbon tab, and the custom property, rather than installing each one separately.

-   **To install:** double-click `CommaTs.tsep` — Tekla's own extension installer takes it from there and puts every file where Tekla expects it. No manual copying.
-   **Supported versions:** Tekla Structures 2024.0 and newer.
-   **Current version:** 26.1.33.

<blockquote class="page-note"><em>uCustomProperty</em> is the one exception: this package includes the Tekla 2026 version only. A site still on Tekla 2024 needs <code>uCustomProperty2024</code> installed separately — see its own entry below.</blockquote>

**Licence:** each computer gets a 45-day trial the first time a Comma tool runs on it, with nothing to register. To keep working after that, request a licence key for the computer:

1.  In Tekla open *Applications & Components* (Ctrl+F), group **Comma**, and run `uCommaLicenseManager`. It shows this computer's Machine ID and the current licence or trial status.
2.  Click *Request a license*, enter the email address the key should be sent to and click *Submit request*. If your mail app opens, press *Send* there.
3.  When the key arrives, paste it into the License key box and click *Activate*.

The same status (Licensed / License expired / Trial days remaining / Trial expired) shows in the top-right corner of every plugin dialog. Details are in the [uCommaLicenseManager](../../model-plugins/ucommalicensemanager/) entry.
